hardware_candidate.gripper: Elephant Robotics original AG adaptive gripper
hardware_candidate.object: one empty 60 mm-class plastic water bottle

protocol_candidate.authority: Elephant Robotics AG product and communication pages
forbidden_examples: FE FE 05 67 VV SS TT FA

field_steps.name: offline_identity_and_hash_review
field_steps.observation: Exact arm, AG, camera, firmware, policy and source identities are recorded.
field_steps.stop_condition: Any identity is missing, mutable, inconsistent or self-reported without evidence.
field_steps.human_isolation: All actuator power remains physically isolated.

field_steps.name: power_off_mount_and_cable_envelope
field_steps.observation: D405 candidate mount, connector, cable service loop and strain relief are inside the reviewed collision envelope and outside finger sweep.
field_steps.stop_condition: Loose mount, cable rub, unreviewed protrusion, unknown bend radius, finger-volume intersection or unapproved mass/center-of-mass change.
field_steps.human_isolation: Safety observer retains physical power isolation; no energized fitting.

field_steps.name: base_lock_and_empty_workspace
field_steps.observation: Base is mechanically locked and power-isolated; arm sweep is empty; one empty bottle is fixed in the approved test fixture.
field_steps.stop_condition: Base can roll, another object/person enters the envelope, bottle pose is not fixed, or physical isolator is unavailable.
field_steps.human_isolation: Named observer holds the accessible physical disconnect.

field_steps.name: camera_only_stationary_admission
field_steps.observation: Fresh eye-in-hand images, exact intrinsics and immutable frame identity show the gripper and single bottle without control output.
field_steps.stop_condition: Multiple/zero bottles, stale frame, exposure failure, stream loss, unresolved self-occlusion, missing calibration or ambiguous camera identity.
field_steps.human_isolation: Actuator power remains isolated throughout camera admission.

field_steps.name: read_only_arm_and_ag_admission
field_steps.observation: Future field session proves unique transport owner, trustworthy stationary arm state and zero-payload AG query framing without writes.
field_steps.stop_condition: Any extended query frame, invalid/out-of-range reply, moving state, unhealthy transport, identity drift, timeout or second owner.
field_steps.human_isolation: Observer can remove actuator energy immediately; read-only admission never proves STOP.

field_steps.name: single_open_command
field_steps.observation: After separate action-level authorization, exactly one bounded two-argument AG write is issued and a fresh image confirms expected direction without collision.
field_steps.stop_condition: Unexpected direction/range, continued motion, stale feedback, camera/cable shift, noise, heat, current anomaly, frame ambiguity or loss of physical isolation.
field_steps.human_isolation: First anomaly causes immediate human power isolation; no reverse command and no retry.

field_steps.name: single_pregrasp_motion
field_steps.observation: One separately authorized low-speed move reaches the reviewed pregrasp pose; a new eye-in-hand frame reacquires the same single bottle and collision clearance remains positive.
field_steps.stop_condition: Bottle identity changes, target exits ROI, arm/gripper occlusion is unresolved, clearance is unmeasured, trajectory deviates, stream freezes or any unexpected motion occurs.
field_steps.human_isolation: Observer isolates power on first anomaly; software STOP alone is insufficient.

field_steps.name: incremental_visual_approach
field_steps.observation: Each separately authorized bounded approach increment is followed by stationary fresh-frame relative-pose and clearance recomputation.
field_steps.stop_condition: No fresh frame, non-monotonic relative motion, bottle ambiguity, self-occlusion beyond validated masks, cable envelope violation, ground/finger clearance loss or pose uncertainty over the approved bound.
field_steps.human_isolation: Only one increment may be outstanding; isolate physically before diagnosis after any anomaly.

field_steps.name: single_empty_bottle_close
field_steps.observation: Exactly one separately authorized two-argument AG close write targets the empty bottle; images and independent observation confirm centered contact without bottle collapse or tool interference.
field_steps.stop_condition: No centered contact, bottle deformation, slip, unexpected continued travel, heat/noise/current anomaly, untrusted feedback or any extended frame emission.
field_steps.human_isolation: Physical disconnect is the primary abnormal-stop path; do not issue a second uncontrolled close or reverse command.

field_steps.name: stationary_hold_evidence
field_steps.observation: A bounded dwell records images, bottle pose, tool pose, feedback, temperature and observer assessment without changing commands.
field_steps.stop_condition: Slip, deformation, rising temperature, transport health loss, identity drift, stale sample or uncertain motion state.
field_steps.human_isolation: Any uncertainty latches physical isolation required; ordinary ACK or close cannot clear it.

field_steps.name: release_and_power_safe_end_state
field_steps.observation: Only after a separately reviewed release plan, one authorized release action leaves the bottle supported and the system reaches a documented power-safe state.
field_steps.stop_condition: Unsupported bottle, unclear release direction, missing clearance, stale camera, untrusted state or inability to verify final energy state.
field_steps.human_isolation: End by verified physical isolation; connection close is not de-energization.

release_statement: This policy is a future field run card only. Offline validation cannot authorize connection, power, motion, field PASS or delivery PASS.
